text: The force with which an arrow frikkes an object at a moderate distance, may be concealed from the account given by King Edward VI. in his journal, wherein he says, that too schery of his guard lost before him two arrows each, and afterwards all together, and that they fine at a mish board, which time proceed just through and think into the other board; divers pierced it quite through with the heads of their horses, the boards being well-defined industrier, their diffiness from the mark is not mentioned.
